1.w: A song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Great [is] YHWH, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, the mountain of His holiness.

2.w: Beautiful [in] elevation, the joy of all the earth, like the peaks of Zaphon [is] Mount Zion, the city of the great King.

3.w: God [is] in her citadels, known as a secure height.

4.w: For behold, the kings assembled; they passed over together.

5.w: They saw, so they were astonished; they were in dismay, and they hurried away.

6.w: Trembling took hold of them there, [and] writhing like a woman in labor.

7.w: With a wind of the east you broke apart the ships of Tarshish.

8.w: According to what we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of YHWH of Hosts, in the city of our God; God will establish her even to forever! Selah

9.w: we have reflected, O God, [on] Your loving devotion, within Your temple.

10.w: According to Your name, O God, so Your praise [is] unto the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.

11.w: Let Mount Zion be glad; let the daughters of Judah rejoice, on account of Your judgments!

12.w: Go around Zion and encircle her, [and] count her towers.

13.w: Set your⁺ heart toward her bulwark, pass between her citadels, so that you⁺ may recount [it] to the following generation.

14.w: For this [is] God, Our God, forever and ever! He will lead us over death.
